Bilal’s M_0=0 loop is the massless chiral-triangle calculation; Preskill separately derives the mass-independent variation for the heavy threshold. Clarify that distinction and have theorem proof step 1.2 explicitly transfer the triangle coefficient to the massive pair using the field-redefinition premise. [Bilal, §5.2.3](https://arxiv.org/pdf/0802.0634); [Preskill, §6.4](https://preskill.caltech.edu/pubs/preskill-1991-effective.pdf).

E is called a bound on external momentum components, but the items do not specify a momentum set or how it constrains their smooth compactly supported backgrounds. If it means Fourier support, the nonzero compactly supported background in the Example cannot have bounded Fourier support; if it means external legs of a perturbative amplitude, those legs are not defined. Define the low-energy condition for a specified amplitude, or separate that interpretation from the exact local anomaly identity and adjust the Example accordingly.
